Walter J. Pietrangeli MRN: 90552108 10/14/2026 11:00 AM Internist at HSS Main
Directions for Your Medications Preoperatively
moved → Mon 11/16 !!
Your surgery is scheduled for Monday, November 9, 2026.
1. Seven (7) days prior to your surgery, do not take the following medications and supplements:
• Regular Aspirin (325mg)
• Vitamins including Multivitamins
• Continue your aspirin 81 mg every day. Do NOT stop it (you have a heart stent).
2. Plavix (clopidogrel) 75 mg: per Dr. Aaron Feld (cardiology), stop five (5) days before surgery. This is
different from the 7 days on the general HSS list.
6. Do not take the following Medication (s) the evening prior to surgery:
Lisinopril
7. Do not take the following Medication(s) the morning of surgery:
Furosemide (Lasix)
Spironolactone
9. Please take the night before surgery:
Insulin glargine (Lantus) – take 80% of your usual dose: 18 units instead of 22 units
Walter J. Pietrangeli (MRN: 90552108) • Printed at 10/14/2026 12:29 PM Page 1 of 4 Epic

Clopidogrel: otherNames ["plavix"], strength "75 mg", action stop, whenText "stop five (5) days before surgery", startDay -5. The cardiologist's 5 days wins over the general 7 days
Lisinopril: action stop, whenText "the evening prior to surgery", startDay -1, endDay -1
Furosemide: otherNames ["lasix"], action stop, whenText "the morning of surgery", startDay 0, endDay 0
Insulin glargine: otherNames ["lantus"], amount "18 units", action take, startDay -1, endDay -1, exception "80% of your usual dose: 18 units instead of 22 units"
